note: Triennial election of the 23 district electoral divisions of Ballymena rural district, one member each (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924). Polling in the contested divisions took place on Thursday 5 June 1924 and the results were declared on 6 June. The News-Letter's results paragraph covers the four contests only; one division (Glenbuck) had no nomination and three others that had two nominations in May produced no recorded poll and are omitted. Sole nomination; sitting member. Name image-checked on the nomination list: "Longmore, John Taggart, J.P. (sitting member)" (corrected from Tugart, gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
